mentions.name: Chattr
mentions.description: A Twitch-specific social network called Chattr. Users log in with Twitch, and the app automatically posts when they go live and posts the VOD to their followers' feed when the stream ends. If someone follows the user on Twitch and joins Chattr, they automatically follow them on the site, making it easier to move a community over. Users can tip and receive tips on posts, which can trigger stream alerts, and can use custom emotes in posts, including by their Twitch subscribers.
mentions.source_excerpt: I have been building a social network for Twitch, called Chattr. It is very Twitch specific as you log in with Twitch and it will automatically post when you go live.
